title: Concept: Requirement declared from a direct URL
description: requirements.txt declares a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index.
